note: Cases derived from a real run (Love & Marriage library, Aug 2026). The run produced a good record and a finished book, but drifted on writing register, duplicated position state across two files, and left old chapter pages asking questions already answered.

evals.prompt: Let's go to the library on love and marriage. I'm fascinated by the idea of love and the idea of marriage and I want to actually understand it, broad and deep, not just search for a spouse.
evals.expected_output: First visit: the building, the shelves, the record, and a stop. The user picks the book.
expectations: Asks what the user wants out of it BEFORE building anything, using AskUserQuestion, two or three questions in one turn
One question captures why they are here; the answer is quoted verbatim on the front desk with an invitation to correct it
One question captures what earns a spot on the shelf (influential / mind-changing / decision-useful / best steelman), multi-select
One question captures breadth -- one tradition or genuinely global -- and where empirical evidence sits
Recommends an option rather than making the user decode the choices, and skips any question the user has already answered
Checks for an existing library directory before building anything
Builds index.html, journey.html, souvenirs.html, shelves.html and RECORD.md, and states what each page answers
Delivers the map and stops -- does not start teaching a book in the same turn
Quotes the user's intention in their own words on the front desk, with an invitation to correct it
Assumes zero prior knowledge; treats any saved documents as bookmarks on one small labelled shelf, never as the syllabus
Never says 'the gap in your reading' or justifies a book by what the user has already covered
Front desk carries exactly one gold-bordered box and it is the pending question

evals.expected_output: Why-chain written into the record as the syllabus, then chapter 1 only, then a stop.
expectations: Invokes BOTH required sub-skills: strip-it-down for the teaching and second-life-writing for the register
Writes the full why-chain into RECORD.md as the book's syllabus before teaching anything
Delivers chapter 1 only, as a one-screen page, and opens it in the browser
Chapter 1 visibly ties back to the user's intention rather than floating as abstract philosophy
Ends the turn on one retrieval question

evals.prompt: [the learner answers chapter 3's question in their own words, half-right]
evals.expected_output: A complete turn: record appended, all renders updated, next chapter delivered, stop.
expectations: Appends the full five-field block to RECORD.md: claim, ASKED verbatim, ANSWERED verbatim, READ, NEXT
Records the learner's answer uncorrected, including their own wording and metaphors
Treats the half-right answer as the next chapter's material rather than repeating chapter 3
Updates the STATE block at the top of RECORD.md before rendering any page
Updates journey.html: the finished stop, the new #now station, the solid-to-dashed boundary, the ring, the counters
Goes back to the PREVIOUS chapter page and marks its question answered with the learner's words
Updates only the question card and the where-you-are line on index.html, nothing else
The pending question is character-identical in RECORD STATE, index.html, journey.html#now and the live chapter page

evals.prompt: [the learner answers the last question in the chain]
evals.expected_output: Book closed properly: souvenir, trophy plaque, stamped spine, journey collapsed, checkout offered.
expectations: Builds the souvenir at souvenirs/<nn>-<slug>.html, numbered by the order the book was finished
The souvenir's talk-back panels are the work's strongest rivals, each aimed at what the learner actually said
Never treats the learner's own saved documents as the talk-back
Adds a filled plaque to souvenirs.html and removes one empty slot
Stamps the finished spine on shelves.html and links it to the souvenir
Collapses the finished book's journey station into a plaque and adds a line to the what-you-now-own ledger
Offers the checkout choice and stops; does not start the next book

evals.prompt: Back to the library on love and marriage.
evals.expected_output: A cold resume driven entirely by the record.
expectations: Reads RECORD.md first and resumes from the recorded position instead of rebuilding
Recovers the exact pending question verbatim from the STATE block rather than re-deriving it
Does not re-teach a chapter already marked delivered
If a rendered page disagrees with the record, the record wins and the page is rebuilt

evals.prompt: This is too simplistic -- a card per book tells me nothing.
evals.expected_output: Depth through chaptering, not through a bigger page.
expectations: Does not respond by building one large complete deep-dive page
Responds by pulling a book and teaching its chain one chapter per turn
Explains the fix in one line without a lecture on the method
